deferred_metrics.reason: Required context or source data is not yet sufficient for provider-compatible results.

team_season_first_game.description: Find one documented team's first recorded regular-season game in one exact season, with opponent, date, venue, score and game evidence.

team_season_final_game.description: Find one documented team's final recorded regular-season game in one exact season, with opponent, date, venue, score and game evidence.

mlb_season_batting_totals_leaders.description: Rank MLB-wide regular-season batting counting-stat totals by season, retaining all ties at the requested rank boundary.

mlb_team_season_batting_metric_leaders.description: Rank MLB database team IDs by complete pooled batting production in one exact regular season, retaining boundary ties.

mlb_team_season_pitching_metric_leaders.description: Rank MLB database team IDs by complete pooled pitching or team-record production in one exact regular season, retaining boundary ties.

team_batting_period_summary.description: Pooled batting totals and rates for one database team ID over an exact or inclusive regular-season period.

team_pitching_period_summary.description: Pooled pitching totals and rates for one database team ID over an exact or inclusive regular-season period.

mlb_season_pooled_batting_rate.description: One MLB season batting rate pooled from underlying totals for an explicitly defined player population.

mlb_season_unweighted_player_batting_rat.description: Arithmetic mean of complete player batting rates for one explicitly defined MLB-season population.

career_batting_leaders.description: Career regular-season batting leaders with a 600 PA minimum.

career_pitching_leaders.description: Career regular-season pitching leaders with a 100 IP minimum.

career_batting_metric_leaders.description: Career regular-season batting leaders by one approved metric, exact PA threshold, direction, optional approved tiebreaker, and competition-rank cutoff ties.

career_pitching_metric_leaders.description: Career regular-season pitching leaders by one approved metric, direction, exact IP/starts thresholds, optional tiebreaker, and competition-rank cutoff ties.

period_pitching_metric_leaders.description: Pitching leaders over an exact season or inclusive period using pooled totals, an approved metric, exact IP/starts thresholds, direction, optional tiebreaker, and competition-rank cutoff ties.

team_season_batting_metric_leaders.description: Tie-inclusive batting leaders for one exact database team ID and regular season by one approved metric and PA threshold.

team_game_batting_condition_count.description: Count one team's exact-season regular-season games satisfying every supplied batting counting-stat condition.

team_season_pitching_metric_leaders.description: Tie-inclusive pitching leaders for one exact database team ID and regular season by one approved metric and IP/starts thresholds.

single_season_batting_leaders.description: Single-season OPS leaders with a 502 PA minimum.

period_batting_metric_leaders.description: Batting leaders over an exact season or inclusive period using pooled totals, an approved metric, exact PA threshold, direction, optional tiebreaker, and competition-rank cutoff ties.

player_batting_top_n_seasons.description: Count seasons one player ranked in an MLB-wide top N for an approved batting metric using competition-rank tie inclusion.

player_batting_condition_seasons.description: Count regular-season player-seasons satisfying every supplied approved batting condition.

player_batting_walk_percentage.description: One player's pooled regular-season walk percentage with walks as numerator and plate appearances as denominator.

player_pitching_rate_summary.description: One pitcher's pooled regular-season strikeout or walk rate for an exact season, inclusive range, career, or one documented database team ID.

player_batting_rate_summary.description: One hitter's pooled regular-season strikeout, walk, or home-run percentage for an exact season, inclusive range, career, or one documented database team ID.

player_fielding_period_summary.description: One player's documented regular-season fielding-error total for an exact season, inclusive range, career, or one database team ID.

player_game_batting_condition_count.description: Count regular-season player games satisfying one approved batting condition after pooling by game ID.

single_season_pitching_leaders.description: Single-season FIP leaders with a 162 IP minimum and valid seasonal context.

season_pitching_fip_leaders.description: FIP leaders for one exact season with a 162 IP minimum and valid seasonal context.

season_pitching_wins_leaders.description: Pitcher wins leaders for one exact regular season without a default qualification threshold.

player_career_batting_summary.description: Career regular-season batting totals for one database-resolved player.

player_season_batting_summary.description: Regular-season batting totals for one database-resolved player in one exact season.

player_latest_season_batting_summary.description: Regular-season batting totals from one database-resolved player's latest recorded season.

player_career_pitching_summary.description: Career regular-season pitching totals and coverage-qualified ERA and FIP for one database-resolved player.

player_season_pitching_summary.description: Exact-season regular-season pitching totals and coverage-qualified ERA and FIP for one database-resolved player.

player_latest_season_pitching_summary.description: Latest recorded regular-season pitching totals and coverage-qualified ERA and FIP for one database-resolved player.

player_first_season_batting_summary.description: Batting totals from one player's first recorded regular-season database season; not an official rookie-eligibility claim.

player_first_season_pitching_summary.description: Pitching totals from one player's first recorded regular-season database season; not an official rookie-eligibility claim.

player_season_two_way_summary.description: Exact-season regular-season batting and pitching evidence for one documented two-way player.

player_two_way_range_summary.description: Pooled batting and pitching evidence for one documented two-way player over an inclusive season range.

semantics.coverage_policy: both batting and pitching evidence required

player_batting_range_summary.description: Pooled regular-season batting totals for one player over an inclusive season range.

player_pitching_range_summary.description: Pooled regular-season pitching totals for one player over an inclusive season range.

player_team_service.description: Documented service by distinct database team ID; does not claim organization or franchise lineage.

player_team_batting_summary.description: Pooled regular-season batting statistics accumulated by one player for one documented database team ID.

player_team_pitching_summary.description: Pooled regular-season pitching statistics accumulated by one player for one documented database team ID.

team_calendar_date_record.description: One team's regular-season record on a recurring month and day from a starting season, with game evidence.

team_season_record.description: One documented team's regular-season record for one exact season, optionally limited to home or away games.

team_opponent_season_record.description: One documented team's regular-season record against one documented opponent in one exact season.

team_opponent_since_record.description: One documented team's regular-season record against one documented opponent from one start season through the latest database season.

relative_pair_eligibility.description: Related-player pairs meeting the initial hitting or pitching eligibility requirements.

best_related_pitching_pair.description: One related pitching pair ranked by lowest pooled career ERA with combined strikeouts as the tiebreaker; minimum 100 IP each.

best_related_hitting_pair.description: One related hitting pair ranked by highest pooled career OPS with combined home runs as the tiebreaker; minimum 600 PA each.

batting_condition_player_seasons.description: Recorded MLB player-seasons matching all explicit approved batting conditions.

player_batting_season_extremum.description: Rank one documented player's individual seasons by an explicit batting metric, retaining peak-season ties.

mlb_batting_period_total.description: Pooled recorded MLB batting counting totals over an explicit inclusive period; incomplete components are withheld.

team_season_venue_records.description: Home and road regular-season records returned as separate labeled rows for one team and season.

zero_starts_pitching_metric_leaders.description: Pitching metric leaders with explicit population: zero_starts

relief_appearances_pitching_metric_leade.description: Pitching metric leaders with explicit population: relief_appearances

player_pitching_rates_summary.description: One player's explicitly requested pitching rates, with each denominator and complete component coverage.

player_batting_condition_matches.description: List the recorded seasons and actual batting values satisfying every condition for one named player.
